confirmed: The /cfg parameter is required when the selected database has no associated security template.
An existing rollback template at the /rbk path is overwritten.
Successful execution logs mismatches to scesrv.log.
The /mergedpolicy switch merges and exports domain and local policy.
The export command requires /cfg; a non-default database can be selected with /db.

conclusion.sourceContract: These references establish the command parameters and file-overwrite behavior, but do not establish an isolated one-setting PasswordComplexity database, safe database initialization, NotDefined restoration, unrelated-setting preservation, or effective managed-policy behavior.
conclusion.nextAcceptance: On disposable Windows 11 and Windows Server 2025, determine whether a target-owned isolated database can be initialized and associated with the one-setting template; then verify local versus merged export, apply/repeat, generated rollback contents, unrelated account-policy preservation, managed precedence, and prior Enabled/Disabled/NotDefined restore before any catalog integration.
